components.heading: When probationer does not receive permanent appointment.
components.text: In the case of a patrol officer not receiving permanent appointment, employment shall cease immediately. In all other cases of employees not receiving permanent appointment, such employees may resume their former position and pay scale. (Ord. 20206 §§ 28, 86, 9-10-19.)
